Package com.neueda.leap.order.settlement

Class SettlementController

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.settlement.SettlementController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/settlements") public class SettlementController extends Object
Operator commands for one settlement (TS-10.3). Service-only: restricted to the OPERATIONS role and not routed by the gateway.

  • Method Details

    • recover

      @PostMapping("/recover") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<SettlementResult> recover(@RequestParam(required=false) String settlementId)
      Completes a partly applied settlement, e.g. POST /settlements/recover?settlementId={fillId}.
      Parameters:
      settlementId - the fill identifier
      Returns:
      200 with the parts repaired, 400 for a malformed id, 404 for an unknown fill, or 409 when it cannot be completed

    • rollback

      @PostMapping("/rollback") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<SettlementResult> rollback(@RequestParam(required=false) String settlementId)
      Rolls back a settlement that has not changed any balance.
      Parameters:
      settlementId - the fill identifier
      Returns:
      200 when rolled back, 400 for a malformed id, 404 for an unknown fill, or 409 when balances already changed

    • status

      @GetMapping("/status/{tradeId}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<SettlementStatusResponse> status(@PathVariable UUID tradeId)
      Returns the ledger-derived settlement state for an order/trade.
      Parameters:
      tradeId - the permanent order identifier
      Returns:
      current settlement state, or 404 when the trade is unknown

    • handle

      @ExceptionHandler(SettlementException.class) public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Map<String,String>> handle(SettlementException failure)
      Returns the failure's fixed code and message.
      Parameters:
      failure - recover or rollback failure
      Returns:
      its status with error and message
